title: Copper wiring made by hand at the Synchrony Hub workshop from the pilot's own stored copper ore, kept in its storage there; a test of the trader's crafting work once the reserve's iron is full
note: 2026-11-17 19:46 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-042 block MERCURY: a trader without a paying trade crafts; rules F23, F30, F31). basic_copper_processing makes 1 copper wiring from 8 copper ore by hand (catalog 0.723.2). The fleet stores 447,390 copper ore against 22,892 the reserve takes and 71,874 held back for other circuit-board recipes (the tool stock, view=reserve, 19:32 UTC); no book within reach bids for copper ore above 4 cr. The wiring is not sold (nothing is crafted for sale here): it is kept as an input of 32 recipes, among them assemble_control_node, and its base value is 21 against 8 copper ore. What this test reads: minutes and crafting XP a run, against gather-okab-belt (-400 per ship-hour of fuel over 124 runs) once the reserve holds its iron. One ship, no lift_to, until its first RESULT line (rule F8).
